_meta.source: Starter values from spec 2.2 (ASCE 7-22 Table 4.3-1). Verify before trusting.
_meta.criterion: Bay study vibration criterion for steel floor lookups (spec 2.2, decision D); null means the Strength rows.

settings.flat_roof_snow_note: null means not given: taken as 0 psf with a warning (spec decisions log, roof snow load source).
settings.vibration_precedence_note: Most stringent first (lower damping). A bay overlapping zones with different criteria uses the first one listed.
settings.kll_note: Corner columns: ASCE 7-22 Table 4.7-1, exterior column without cantilever slabs = 4 (decisions log). Edge columns: spec 4.1 value 2, conservative; ASCE allows 4 without cantilever slabs. With cantilever slabs ASCE gives edge 3, corner 2.

storage_light.note: ASCE allows 20% reduction for columns supporting 2+ levels; not used for the hackathon

mechanical.note: Firm standard, not an ASCE table value

roof.note: Lr, reduced per ASCE 7-22 4.8 (not 4.7); snow handled as a flat input in settings
